We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template as result of task make_7_lvl1-template_search-1 to the molecule. We have input from make_7_lvl1-template_search-1: question about mapped_rxn for template 324324. But we need precursors of applying the template (presumably the same template ID?) The task: "Task make_7_lvl1-apply_template-1: Can you return all possible precursors of applying the template as the result of the task make_7_lvl1-template_search-1 to the molecule below?" So we need to apply the template that was found in previous task. The previous task gave a mapped_rxn associated with template 324324. But we need the template ID. Likely template ID is 324324. So we need to apply that template to the given molecule SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

Thus we need to get the template SMARTS via get_template, then apply_template to molecule. Then output list of lists of precursor SMILES combos.

Let's do that.
